project_info.application_name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Management System
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier architecture with external charging stations connecting through Network Load Balancer to containerized services on AWS Fargate. Internal microservices communicate through Application Load Balancer. Web application served via CloudFront CDN with API Gateway backend. Segregated component groups include: (1) OCPP connection handler, (2) Web application, (3) EVSE registry, (4) EVSE management, (5) Smart charging, (6) Transaction management and audit, (7) Central load balancing layer connecting all microservices.
key_components: OCPP Connection Handler (ELB, Fargate, DynamoDB, Lambda)
Web Application (CloudFront, API Gateway, Cognito, S3)
External entities: Charging stations, Charge point operators, Fleet management, Smart meters, Roaming networks
project_info.\"scalability\": "Serverless and containerized architecture enables automatic scaling based on demand"
